dialogues.jp: 「叶、飯行こうぜ。飯っ」
dialogues.en: "Kudou, let's go eat. It's lunchtime."
dialogues.text: "Kudou, let's go eat. It's lunchtime."

dialogues.jp: 俺は弁当の包みを手にして叶に声をかけた。
dialogues.en: I called out to Kanae, who was holding a bundled lunchbox.
dialogues.text: I called out to Kanae, who was holding a bundled lunchbox.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.en: "Coming..."
dialogues.text: "Coming..."

dialogues.jp: 周りに気兼ねするかのような、控えめの返事。
dialogues.en:
Still uncertain of her surroundings, her reply was
diffident.
dialogues.text:
Still uncertain of her surroundings, her reply was
diffident.

dialogues.speaker: Guy A
dialogues.jp: 「お、今日もだぜ」
dialogues.en: "Ooh, today too?"
dialogues.text: "Ooh, today too?"

dialogues.speaker: Guy B
dialogues.jp: 「仲｛むつ／睦｝まじいことで、｛うらや／羨｝ましいな〜」
dialogues.en: "Seeing two people click so well is so enviable~"
dialogues.text: "Seeing two people click so well is so enviable~"

dialogues.jp:
席を立った叶に、教室のあちこちから冷やかし
の声にまじった口笛が飛んでくる。
dialogues.en:
As Kanae stood up from her desk, the inevitable catcalls,
whistles and teasing began.
dialogues.text:
As Kanae stood up from her desk, the inevitable catcalls,
whistles and teasing began.

dialogues.jp: 何とでも言うがいい。
dialogues.en: Whatever they want to say, I don't care.
dialogues.text: Whatever they want to say, I don't care.

dialogues.jp: 幸せ一杯な俺には痛くも｛かゆ／痒｝くもないぜ。
dialogues.en:
Their taunts just bounce off with the amount of happiness I
have.
dialogues.text:
Their taunts just bounce off with the amount of happiness I
have.

dialogues.jp: 「どうだ、うらやましいか？」
dialogues.en: "How's that, aren't you jealous?"
dialogues.text: "How's that, aren't you jealous?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉君っ……」
dialogues.en: "A, Asakuraaa..."
dialogues.text: "A, Asakuraaa..."

dialogues.jp: 困ったような声を出す叶の手をとる。
dialogues.en: Worried, she gestured with her hand to stop.
dialogues.text: Worried, she gestured with her hand to stop.

dialogues.jp: （嫁さんか……花嫁衣裳も可愛いんだろうな）
dialogues.en: "Come on, let's go."
dialogues.text: "Come on, let's go."

dialogues.jp:
色々な想像をめぐらせては、ひとり頬をゆるま
せる。
dialogues.en: "Let's hurry up and start eating."
dialogues.text: "Let's hurry up and start eating."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.en: "I don't mind that..."
dialogues.text: "I don't mind that..."

dialogues.jp:
そう言いながらおぼろ昆布で巻かれた握り飯に
ぱくりとかぶりつく。
dialogues.en:
"Your food is so delicious, I can't stand having them in
front of me for long."
dialogues.text:
"Your food is so delicious, I can't stand having them in
front of me for long."

dialogues.jp: とても美味い。
dialogues.en:
Having chosen a deserted place to eat, I slapped the ground
a few times, gesturing her to sit down.
dialogues.text:
Having chosen a deserted place to eat, I slapped the ground
a few times, gesturing her to sit down.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.en: "You're acting just like a kid. Calm down a bit."
dialogues.text: "You're acting just like a kid. Calm down a bit."

dialogues.jp:
ほとんど聞こえるか聞こえないかという小さな
声で、叶がつぶやく。
dialogues.en:
Her tone had changed into a far more feminine one, that most
of the school had never heard before. The difference was
huge.
dialogues.text:
Her tone had changed into a far more feminine one, that most
of the school had never heard before. The difference was
huge.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「なんで？　別に無理なんかしてないけど？」
dialogues.en:
"Today's menu is hijiki with rice, grilled sawara, and
cabbage with sesame seeds."
dialogues.text:
"Today's menu is hijiki with rice, grilled sawara, and
cabbage with sesame seeds."

dialogues.jp:
手のひらについた飯粒を｛は／剥｝がして口に入れつつ
答える。
dialogues.en: "Amazing as usual."
dialogues.text: "Amazing as usual."

dialogues.jp:
「誰にも邪魔されず彼女と二人きりの昼飯。し
　かもこんなに美味しい弁当を作ってきてもらっ
　てさ……」
dialogues.en:
Once I completely settled down, she opened the lid,
releasing a aromatic scent.
dialogues.text:
Once I completely settled down, she opened the lid,
releasing a aromatic scent.

dialogues.jp:
「なんていうか本当、幸せを噛み締めておりま
　す」
dialogues.en: She then handed over a pair of chopsticks.
dialogues.text: She then handed over a pair of chopsticks.

dialogues.jp: 「何か問題？」
dialogues.en: "Hmm, now, open your mouth. Ahhh!"
dialogues.text: "Hmm, now, open your mouth. Ahhh!"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「……別にそんなの変でも誤解でもないだろ」
dialogues.en: "Ehh~, again?"
dialogues.text: "Ehh~, again?"

dialogues.jp: 事実恋人同士なわけだし。
dialogues.en: "No?"
dialogues.text: "No?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.en: "It's not that..."
dialogues.text: "It's not that..."

dialogues.jp: それでも叶は納得せず、唇を噛んで黙り込む。
dialogues.en:
As she said that, she cut and picked up a piece of the fish
with ehr chopsticks, and moved it towards my mouth.
dialogues.text:
As she said that, she cut and picked up a piece of the fish
with ehr chopsticks, and moved it towards my mouth.

dialogues.en: "Ahh, it really is delicious~"
dialogues.text: "Ahh, it really is delicious~"

dialogues.jp:
俺は口の中のきんぴらごぼうを飲み込むと弁当
箱を押しやり、やにわに叶を抱きすくめた。
dialogues.en:
It had an elegant taste to it. Neither exciting nor flashy,
but a calming taste. Food that makes you glad to be
Japanese.
dialogues.text:
It had an elegant taste to it. Neither exciting nor flashy,
but a calming taste. Food that makes you glad to be
Japanese.

dialogues.jp: そのまま、少し強引に唇を重ねる。
dialogues.en: "Now, it's your turn."
dialogues.text: "Now, it's your turn."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.en: "I... I'm fine."
dialogues.text: "I... I'm fine."

dialogues.jp:
ほどなくして、俺の胸板にくたりと身が預けら
れる。
dialogues.en:
My chopsticks were pushed away by hers, to emphasize her
point.
dialogues.text:
My chopsticks were pushed away by hers, to emphasize her
point.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.en:
"I mean, if we keep doing this in school, we're going to get
found out eventually. And if we do, you know how the class
is..."
dialogues.text:
"I mean, if we keep doing this in school, we're going to get
found out eventually. And if we do, you know how the class
is..."

dialogues.jp:
「なにが困るかって言えば、お前にそんな風な
　悩んだ顔されるのが一番困る」
dialogues.en:
Kanae had switched back to guy mode, as she started to dig
in to the meal.
dialogues.text:
Kanae had switched back to guy mode, as she started to dig
in to the meal.

dialogues.jp: 俺のことで悲しい顔なんかして欲しくない。
dialogues.en: "I guess that's true... restraint would be a good idea."
dialogues.text: "I guess that's true... restraint would be a good idea."

dialogues.jp:
俺はそう言いながら叶の前髪を軽くかきあげ、
額に触れた。
dialogues.en: I followed suit, stuffing my face.
dialogues.text: I followed suit, stuffing my face.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.en:
"Of course... I still really enjoy eating together like
this."
dialogues.text:
"Of course... I still really enjoy eating together like
this."

dialogues.jp:
その手に叶の手がそっと重ねられる。白くて細
い指だった。
dialogues.en:
It seems like if it wasn't for me, that she wouldn't have to
keep switching between modes like this. It's almost as if--
dialogues.text:
It seems like if it wasn't for me, that she wouldn't have to
keep switching between modes like this. It's almost as if--

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「だから謝るな〜」
dialogues.en: "--Thank you for the meal."
dialogues.text: "--Thank you for the meal."

dialogues.jp: こつんとこづく振り。
dialogues.en:
While I was thinking off to myself, she'd already finished
her portion. I was jealous and impressed by refined way she
eats.
dialogues.text:
While I was thinking off to myself, she'd already finished
her portion. I was jealous and impressed by refined way she
eats.

dialogues.jp: たく、俺の心配なんかしなくていいってのに。
dialogues.en: --Then I decided to be bold.
dialogues.text: --Then I decided to be bold.

dialogues.jp: （叶は……優しすぎるんだよな）
dialogues.en: "Kanae, your cheek--"
dialogues.text: "Kanae, your cheek--"

dialogues.jp:
「そのことはもういいから、昼飯のつづき、ほ
　ら、口あけて」
dialogues.en: "Ehh?"
dialogues.text: "Ehh?"

dialogues.jp:
俺は箸でつまんだオカズを叶の口元に持っていっ
た。
dialogues.en:
Before she could touch it with her fingers, my lips got
there first.
dialogues.text:
Before she could touch it with her fingers, my lips got
there first.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「え？　や、やだ、自分で食べられるよ！」
dialogues.en: "A, Asakura..."
dialogues.text: "A, Asakura..."

dialogues.jp: 「残念ながらこれは恋人の｛つうかぎれい／通過儀礼｝なんだ」
dialogues.en: "Mmmm."
dialogues.text: "Mmmm."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「…………恥ずかしい仕来りだね………………」
dialogues.en: "I told you already. What'd you do if someone saw that..."
dialogues.text: "I told you already. What'd you do if someone saw that..."

dialogues.jp:
照れくさそうに目を閉じた表情に先程の自分の
強引な行動を思い出し、今更ながら頬が熱くな
るのを感じた。
dialogues.en: "Don't worry, no one's around anyway."
dialogues.text: "Don't worry, no one's around anyway."

dialogues.jp:
ひとくち大のおかずを何度か｛そしゃく／咀嚼｝して飲み込む
と、今度は叶が同じように弁当箱へ箸をつける。
dialogues.en:
Kanae rubbed the area where I had kissed, looking around
her. Everyone should've went back to class by now, though.
dialogues.text:
Kanae rubbed the area where I had kissed, looking around
her. Everyone should've went back to class by now, though.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「……じゃあ、朝倉君もあーんしてください」
dialogues.en: "Geez, so negligent."
dialogues.text: "Geez, so negligent."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.en: Haah... even her sighs were elegant.
dialogues.text: Haah... even her sighs were elegant.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「ほら、通過儀礼」
dialogues.en: "--Since no one's around though, do as you wish."
dialogues.text: "--Since no one's around though, do as you wish."

dialogues.jp: ……確かにこれは猛烈に恥ずかしい。
dialogues.en: She lifted up her head towards me as she spoke.
dialogues.text: She lifted up her head towards me as she spoke.

dialogues.jp:
それから俺達は昼休みいっぱいをかけて二人か
わりばんこに弁当箱の中身を片付けた。
dialogues.en: "Understood, princess."
dialogues.text: "Understood, princess."

dialogues.en: I gave her other cheek a small kiss as well.
dialogues.text: I gave her other cheek a small kiss as well.

dialogues.jp:
そんなこそばゆいランチタイムを終えて教室に
戻ると、ざわめきが一斉に俺達を包んだ。
dialogues.en:
As we ended lunchtime and returned to the classroom that
way, the entire class suddenly turned to stare at us.
dialogues.text:
As we ended lunchtime and returned to the classroom that
way, the entire class suddenly turned to stare at us.

dialogues.jp:
気のせいじゃない。クラスの連中、ことに男子
があからさまな好奇の視線を向けてきている。
dialogues.en:
It's definitely not my iamgination. Every guy in the class
was staring at us in curiosity.
dialogues.text:
It's definitely not my iamgination. Every guy in the class
was staring at us in curiosity.

dialogues.speaker: Guy A
dialogues.jp: 「…………やっぱりアイツら、本物だったんだ」
dialogues.en: ".....Looks like they're the real thing."
dialogues.text: ".....Looks like they're the real thing."

dialogues.speaker: Guy B
dialogues.jp: 「やっべ……シャレんなんねぇじゃん」
dialogues.en: "Maybe... we shouldn't have joked about it..."
dialogues.text: "Maybe... we shouldn't have joked about it..."

dialogues.jp: そんな｛ささや／囁｝き声が漏れ聞こえる。
dialogues.en:
The murmurs reached my ears thanks to the otherwise silent
classroom.
dialogues.text:
The murmurs reached my ears thanks to the otherwise silent
classroom.

dialogues.jp:
「何なんだよ！　言いたいことがあるならハッ
　キリ言えばいいだろ」
dialogues.en:
"What's up with you guys? If you have something to say, just
spit it out!"
dialogues.text:
"What's up with you guys? If you have something to say, just
spit it out!"

dialogues.speaker: Guy C
dialogues.jp:
「いや……二組の山岡が、お前らがキスしてる
　とこ見たって……本当なのか？」
dialogues.en:
"Erm... Class 2's Yamamoto said he saw you two kissing... is
that true?"
dialogues.text:
"Erm... Class 2's Yamamoto said he saw you two kissing... is
that true?"

dialogues.jp: やば……見られてたのか！？
dialogues.en: Don't tell me... he really saw us!?
dialogues.text: Don't tell me... he really saw us!?

dialogues.jp: （油断してたなぁ……）
dialogues.en: "(I really was negligent...)"
dialogues.text: "(I really was negligent...)"

dialogues.jp:
いかにひとけが無いとはいえ……屋上には誰で
も入れる。
dialogues.en:
The first one, I had looked around beforehand, but the
second one...
dialogues.text:
The first one, I had looked around beforehand, but the
second one...

dialogues.jp:
そして今日のように良い陽気のお昼時、外の風
に吹かれて飯を食いたいと思う奴がいても何も
不思議はない。
dialogues.en: That one, I don't remember whether I did.
dialogues.text: That one, I don't remember whether I did.

dialogues.speaker: Guy A
dialogues.jp: 「い、いや、俺ら別に気にしないから、うん」
dialogues.en: "O, oh, it's not a problem with me, at all!"
dialogues.text: "O, oh, it's not a problem with me, at all!"

dialogues.speaker: Guy B
dialogues.jp: 「ほ、ほんとほんと」
dialogues.en: "Y, yeah, really!"
dialogues.text: "Y, yeah, really!"

dialogues.jp:
とか笑いながらにじにじと遠ざかっていく男連
中。
dialogues.en:
The smiles and forced laughter were painfully obvious.
They've completely misunderstood.
dialogues.text:
The smiles and forced laughter were painfully obvious.
They've completely misunderstood.

dialogues.jp:
「な、何を言ってるんだよ、そんなの見間違い
　に決まってるだろ。何か変なものでも食った
　んじゃないのか？」
dialogues.en:
"W, what are you talking about, of course it was a mistake.
You guys didn't eat anything weird, did you?"
dialogues.text:
"W, what are you talking about, of course it was a mistake.
You guys didn't eat anything weird, did you?"

dialogues.jp: 取りあえず精一杯のごまかし。
dialogues.en: First things first, deception attempt.
dialogues.text: First things first, deception attempt.

dialogues.jp:
「な、工藤」と同意を求めて振り返ると、叶は
顔を伏せたまま微動だにもしなかった。
dialogues.en:
"Right, Kudou?" I said, as I tried to look at her for
support. But I was sadly mistaken.
dialogues.text:
"Right, Kudou?" I said, as I tried to look at her for
support. But I was sadly mistaken.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「も、もしもし……工藤さん？」
dialogues.en: "H, hello... Kudou-san?"
dialogues.text: "H, hello... Kudou-san?"

dialogues.jp:
顔を覗き込むと、叶は真赤になってぷいと横を
向いてしまった。
dialogues.en:
I peered into her face, and saw that it was coloured bright
red.
dialogues.text:
I peered into her face, and saw that it was coloured bright
red.

dialogues.en: "Oh dear..."
dialogues.text: "Oh dear..."

dialogues.speaker: Guy C
dialogues.jp: 「あ〜、王子様に嫌われた〜〜〜」
dialogues.en: "Ahhh~, the prince is disturbed~~~"
dialogues.text: "Ahhh~, the prince is disturbed~~~"

dialogues.jp: 俺の周りで野郎どもがいっせいにはやし立てる。
dialogues.en: The bastards around me all started laughing at once.
dialogues.text: The bastards around me all started laughing at once.

dialogues.jp:
あれから何度もコンタクトを取ろうとしたもの
のものの見事に失敗。
dialogues.en:
No matter how many times I tried to talk to her after that,
each and every one was a spectacular failure.
dialogues.text:
No matter how many times I tried to talk to her after that,
each and every one was a spectacular failure.

dialogues.jp:
帰りのＨＲが終わると、叶はひとりで先に教室
を出て行ってしまった。
dialogues.en:
After HR finished, she immediately left the classroom by
herself.
dialogues.text:
After HR finished, she immediately left the classroom by
herself.

dialogues.jp: 「はううう……」
dialogues.en: "Haaaaaahh..."
dialogues.text: "Haaaaaahh..."

dialogues.jp:
ずるずると自分の机にへたりこんで自己嫌悪に
陥っている俺の上に、ぼすっと鞄が降って来た。
dialogues.en:
I fell forward onto the desk, wallowing in self-loathing. It
wasn't long though, before a bag falling on top of me got me
up.
dialogues.text:
I fell forward onto the desk, wallowing in self-loathing. It
wasn't long though, before a bag falling on top of me got me
up.

dialogues.jp: 「ってーなー……何するよ！」
dialogues.en: "What the... what're you doing!"
dialogues.text: "What the... what're you doing!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「たく、だから忠告しただろ」
dialogues.en: "Pah, I was just going to give you some news."
dialogues.text: "Pah, I was just going to give you some news."

dialogues.jp: そこには、呆れたような杉並の顔。
dialogues.en: Suginami stood there, a disapproving look on his face.
dialogues.text: Suginami stood there, a disapproving look on his face.

dialogues.jp: 「……なんだよ」
dialogues.en: "...What is it."
dialogues.text: "...What is it."

dialogues.jp: この馬鹿者めと杉並は続ける。
dialogues.en: I let the idiot continue.
dialogues.text: I let the idiot continue.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en:
"The matters between you two have spread quickly. Kudou has
apparently went to a teacher for advice on the situation."
dialogues.text:
"The matters between you two have spread quickly. Kudou has
apparently went to a teacher for advice on the situation."

dialogues.jp: 背筋がひやりとした。

そんなことになれば、叶の秘密はいちどきに露
見してしまう。
dialogues.en: THe muscles in my back stiffened all at once.
dialogues.text: THe muscles in my back stiffened all at once.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「どうすればいいか……よく考えてみるんだな。
　愛する者の危機に際してどう立ち回れるか、
　だ」
dialogues.en:
If that's the case, then surely her secret's going to be
discovered.
dialogues.text:
If that's the case, then surely her secret's going to be
discovered.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en:
"Think very carefully on what you should do. Lovers in a
quarrel are especially dangerous."
dialogues.text:
"Think very carefully on what you should do. Lovers in a
quarrel are especially dangerous."

dialogues.jp: （俺が出来ること……）
考え付くことは、ただの一つしかない。
dialogues.en:
With an extremely unusual serious face, he threw his bag
over his shoulder, and left.
dialogues.text:
With an extremely unusual serious face, he threw his bag
over his shoulder, and left.

dialogues.jp:
そしてそれを実行するためには……強い強い、
意志の力が必要だった。
dialogues.en:
Thoughts ran through my mind as I watched his figure
disappear through the door.
dialogues.text:
Thoughts ran through my mind as I watched his figure
disappear through the door.

dialogues.jp: ◆君の為にできること◆
dialogues.en: "(What can I do...)"
dialogues.text: "(What can I do...)"

dialogues.jp: 叶と屋上で昼飯。
dialogues.en: As much as I thought, I could only come up with one.
dialogues.text: As much as I thought, I could only come up with one.

dialogues.jp:
叶は、自分のせいで俺が無理をしているのでは
ないかと言う。
dialogues.en:
And to perform that will take... tons and tons of willpower
and determination.
dialogues.text:
And to perform that will take... tons and tons of willpower
and determination.

dialogues.jp:
絶対にそんなことはない。俺はそんな叶を抱き
すくめ強引にキスをしたのだった。
dialogues.en: ◆The Things I Can Do For You◆
dialogues.text: ◆The Things I Can Do For You◆

dialogues.jp:
昼飯を終えて、戻った教室内は騒然としていた。
俺と叶のキスを見ていた奴がいたのだ。
dialogues.en:
After lunchtime ended, confusion reigned in the classroom we
returmned to. Someone had saw Kanae and I kissing.
dialogues.text:
After lunchtime ended, confusion reigned in the classroom we
returmned to. Someone had saw Kanae and I kissing.

dialogues.jp:
このままでは叶の秘密がばれるのも時間の問題
だろう。
dialogues.en:
It's only a matter of time before Kanae's secret gets
revealed at this rate.
dialogues.text:
It's only a matter of time before Kanae's secret gets
revealed at this rate.

dialogues.jp:
叶を守るために出来ること、考えつくこたえは、
ただ一つしかなかった。
dialogues.en:
I thought about what I could do to protect her, and came up
with just one answer.
dialogues.text:
I thought about what I could do to protect her, and came up
with just one answer.
